mapper.select: Select b.emp_no as empNo, a.user_no as userNo, a.user_id as userId, a.password as userPassword, a.user_nm as userName, b.sub_dept_code as deptCode, SF_PROJ_NAME(b.sub_dept_code) as deptName, C.POSITION_CODE as positionCode, SF_POSITION_NAME(B.POSITION_CODE) as positionName, C.SEQ AS posSeq, a.USE_FG as useFlag From TCC_EMPLOYE a ,THR_PM_BASE b ,THR_POSITION_CODE c Where a.empno = b.EMP_NO AND B.POSITION_CODE = C.POSITION_CODE And a.user_id = #{userId} And a.USE_FG = 'T'

select proj_code as projCode, proj_name as projName from tcc_proj_code e where proj_knd_tg = 'S' and exists( select 'y' from TAC_F_REQ_FUND_WORK k where to_char(k.work_ym,'yyyy') = decode(to_char(sysdate,'yyyy'),'2024',to_char(sysdate,'yyyy'),to_char(sysdate,'yyyy')-1) and k.proj_code = e.proj_code ) AND PROJ_CODE NOT IN ('2021022402','2021021901','2021022404','2014062501','2021022403','2021022405','2014062502','2021022406','2021022407') order by proj_code
